name: Transport
definition: Moving of goods or people from one place to another by vehicle.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification of the means of transport, such as the International Maritime Organization number of a vessel.

ArrivalDateTime.name: Arrival Date Time
ArrivalDateTime.definition: Date and time when the goods reach their destination..

PartialShipment.name: Partial Shipment
PartialShipment.definition: Indicates whether or not partial shipments are allowed.

TransShipment.name: Trans Shipment
TransShipment.definition: Indicates whether or not transshipment of goods is allowed.

FreightChargesPrepaidOrCollect.name: Freight Charges Prepaid Or Collect
FreightChargesPrepaidOrCollect.definition: Identifies whether the freight charges associated with the items are "prepaid" or "collect".

Incoterms.name: Incoterms
Incoterms.definition: Specifies the applicable Incoterm and associated location.

Packaging.name: Packaging
Packaging.definition: Physical packaging of goods for transport.

ProductDelivery.name: Product Delivery
ProductDelivery.definition: Specifies the delivery parameters of a trade.

PlaceOfDeparture.name: Place Of Departure
PlaceOfDeparture.definition: Place from where the goods must leave.

PlaceOfDestination.name: Place Of Destination
PlaceOfDestination.definition: Place where the goods must arrive.

TransportCharges.name: Transport Charges
TransportCharges.definition: Charges related to the conveyance of goods.

ShipmentDates.name: Shipment Dates
ShipmentDates.definition: Specifies the shipment date, the earliest shipment date and the latest shipment date.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to the transport of goods.

TransitLocation.name: Transit Location
TransitLocation.definition: Place through which the goods are transiting.

TransportDocuments.name: Transport Documents
TransportDocuments.definition: Documents which may be required in relation with the transportation of goods.
